ctx.x: Bob Arburn, March 27th, 1957, Real 1. My name is Bob Arburn. Your name is Bob Campbell, right? Right. Bob Campbell. Hello, Bob. How are you? How are you? When were you born, Paul? Well, I tell you, I was born May the 5th. 1901.
